proposed.text: What is the KEY distinction between PSO and FLAR as building size controls under the Philippine framework?

options.text: PSO and FLAR both control total floor area — either alone is sufficient, which is a misunderstanding of their distinct roles
PSO controls the building's horizontal footprint (ground coverage); FLAR controls the total aggregate floor area across all floors
FLAR controls the ground-floor footprint; PSO controls the total number of floors allowed, which is an incorrect interpretation of their functions
PSO applies only to residential buildings; FLAR applies only to commercial buildings, a simplification that does not reflect actual regulations
